request: A box for an ESP32-DevKitC V4 board (54.4 x 27.9 mm, 1.6 mm thick, pin headers pointing up about 8.5 mm). The board has no mounting holes, so the box must hold it with ribs or clips instead of screws. The micro-USB end must be open for a cable, so a micro-USB plug can be pushed in with the lid on. The antenna end of the board needs 8 mm of empty space beyond the board and no wall or lid material above the module. The lid is a separate printed part that snaps on and can be taken off again. Printed on an FDM printer in PLA without supports, and the closed box should be no larger than 75 x 45 x 25 mm. Requirements: The design shall place the ESP32-DevKitC from the parts catalogue with its micro-USB end facing one short end of the box and its antenna end facing the opposite short end, and shall declare that layout. The 54.4 x 27.9 x 1.6 mm board shall fit inside the closed box with at least 0.5 mm clearance to every printed surface, apart from the features that hold it (supports, ribs and stops), which stay at least 0.2 mm off it except where the board rests on its supports. The board shall be held without screws by at least three supports under it (each at least 4.0 mm2 in plan, outside the pin-tail strips, tops level within 0.10 mm and touching its underside), at least two retention ribs over its top at the USB end (one per long edge, undersides 0.1 to 0.3 mm above the board top) and stops at all four edges (0.1 to 0.3 mm from the board edge), so that it cannot move more than 1.0 mm along its length, 0.6 mm across it or 0.5 mm up or down. With the lid closed, no part of the box shall come within 10.6 mm above the board's top surface (header pins 8.5 mm plus 0.5 mm, above the 1.6 mm board) or within 3.3 mm below its underside (pin tails plus 0.3 mm), except the supports under the board and the retention ribs. With the lid closed, a micro-USB plug shall push fully into the board's receptacle through one opening in the end wall without touching the box (at least 0.3 mm clear of the plug on every side), the receptacle front stands 0.5 to 3.0 mm behind the inner face of the end wall, at least 1.5 mm of wall surrounds the opening, and that opening shall be no more than 1.5 mm bigger than the plug on any side. At the antenna end, no wall, lid or rib material shall enter the 8 mm of free space beyond the board end or the volume above the antenna module, and the free length beyond the board end shall be no more than 12.0 mm. The box shall be a base and a separate removable lid that locates on the base with a sliding fit (a continuous lip with 0.15 to 0.35 mm clearance per side, 1.0 to 2.0 mm engagement and at least 0.8 mm thickness). The lid shall be held closed by snap hooks on at least two opposite walls, engaging with at least 0.4 mm of undercut, flexing within a 2 percent strain limit, and shall be removable by hand. Each hook arm shall be 1.2 to 2.0 mm thick, at least 9.0 mm free length and at least 5.0 mm wide, with an undercut of at most 1.0 mm, a retention face 45 to 65 degrees and a lead-in face 20 to 40 degrees from horizontal, and every hook shall still be engaged when the lid is lifted 0.3 mm. The closed box shall have no openings other than the USB opening, and its walls, floor and lid shall be 2.0 to 4.0 mm thick. The base and the lid shall each be one manifold body that prints on an FDM printer without supports (45 degree overhang limit, at least half of each part's plan area flat on the bed, no feature thinner than 0.8 mm). The closed box shall be no larger than 75 x 45 x 25 mm and shall stand flat on a table without tipping. With the lid off, the board shall drop straight down onto its supports without touching anything (at least 0.2 mm clear), and the lid shall close on the base without any part other than the snap hooks being forced. The design shall be delivered as a base STL, a lid STL, the OpenSCAD source, the declared board layout and the agent's own clearance report, and that report shall agree with an independent measurement to within 0.10 mm.
